_about: The one list of the board kinds of TFN OS. tfn.py reads it (build, flash, ports); tests/boards/check_boards.py
checks it against the files of the repo (the sdkconfig defaults, the partition tables, boards/<kind>/board_caps.h,
main/apps.json, sdk/tools/abi_gen.py, the release build tool, the flash tool, site/js/boards.js).
chip: the IDF_TARGET. sdkconfig_defaults: the files in their order (a later file wins). partition_table: the CSV
that the build uses (the last CONFIG_PARTITION_TABLE_CUSTOM_FILENAME of the defaults). flash_size: the size that
the build writes in the image header; flash_chip_mb: the size of the flash chip on the board.
console_usb: the USB VID:PID of the port of the console (hex). frame: the frame of the apps (LCD_W x LCD_H), the
native frame and the round HI frame (0 = none) of boards/<kind>/board_caps.h.
boot_md5: the known MD5 values of the bootloader of a build, with the bytes 0x48..0x63 (the build date) and the
last 33 bytes (the checksum and the SHA-256) set to 0 (Boot-Hash of the flash tool). An empty list = no known value.
flash: the write plan of tfn flash (the addresses in the flash of the board).
release: true = a kind of the public release (.github/workflows/release.yml KINDS, site/js/boards.js "web: true").
manager_release: true = a kind that only the release of the manager builds (not a kind of the public release); the release build tool ORDER = the release kinds and these kinds.
release_cfg: the values of a public release build after force_cfg (sdk/tools/release_cfg.py force).
A null value = not found in the files of the repo; its note tells why.

force_cfg._note: the values of FORCE_CFG in the release build tool: each sdkconfig of a kind gets them before its build (only when the sdkconfig has the option)

release_cfg._note: the values of a public release build (sdk/tools/release_cfg.py force, after force_cfg): the values of RELEASE_CFG in the release build tool with no OTA mode (release_cfg.py sets ENFORCE when the release has its OTA key, else REPORT)

tables._note: the partition tables that a board can have (the MD5 of the 0xC00 bytes at 0x8000), and the place of the otadata in each

6f7c496edd92e2c9098b4f4bdcec4c73.note: a wide firmware (the CoreS3) changes a slim board by itself at its first start (main/layout.c)

0cc7d0ab6f2c123d340f22ffcf785ff3.note: the old full layout: the slim firmware changes the layout by itself at its first start (main/layout.c)

72bd4dd1fff5f6131209050257bf154c.note: the layout before the OTA slots: the flash tool refuses it (no CSV of it is in the repo)

3faadc0589f3508373e40d98310f94b2.source: the partition-table.bin of a DEV build of am175 (the flash tool has no am175 entry)

lcd349.name: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-3.49
notes: sdkconfig.defaults names partitions.csv first and partitions_slim.csv later: the later line wins

am18.name: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.8
notes: round_hi: no own BOARD_ROUND_HI, so main/tfn/board.h gives BOARD_NATIVE_W (the panel is not round)

watcher.name: Seeed SenseCAP Watcher
notes: the console is UART0 through the CH342 USB-UART chip (sdkconfig.defaults.watcher); the CH342 gives two ports
the build uses 16 MB of the 32 MB flash (sdkconfig.defaults.watcher)
baud: the flash tool uses 460800 for this board

am175.name: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.75C
notes: boot_md5: the flash tool has no entry for this kind; boot_md5_build is the value of a DEV build, not checked on a board
tfn flash --first-time stops while boot_md5 is empty (give --force to write the bootloader of the build)

tab5.name: M5Stack Tab5
notes: the bootloader, the table and the boot menu (the factory slot) belong to the Tab5Boot project: tfn writes only the app
the app goes into the slot tfn_a (partitions_tab5.csv); tfn erases the otadata first, as Tab5Boot does for TFN
boot_md5: the flash tool has no entry for this kind; tfn does not write the bootloader of this kind

crow7.name: Elecrow CrowPanel Advance 7.0
notes: 800 x 480 16-bit RGB565 panel; 360 x 640 (640 x 360 landscape) tablet app frame scaled to fill the full 800 x 480 screen
